dct_title_s: [Russian Empire nautical charts]. G7001 .P5 SVAR .R8 SHEET 713
dct_description_sm: Relief shown by hachures, contours and spot heights on some sheets. Depths shown by gradient tints and soundings on some sheets.
Most charts include names of editors, compilers, etc.
Some sheets have annotations and corrections.
Each sheet numbered in lower margin, e.g.: 12-A.
LC copy incomplete: Some charts published within this range of years missing.
Includes tables of tidal information and chart datum. Some sheets include 1 or more insets.
